# Nu vänder det – 3 aktier att köpa

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts are broadly positive on the market. They point to Nvidia's very strong report and its guidance for 70% growth next year as a driver of global earnings, and to strong Swedish GDP (+3.3%) and confidence data. They expect a good autumn and 12 months of gains, with a market top called for around August 2027. Stock picks favour beaten-down names: Elekta, Addnode (a bet against the 'SaaS-death' story after Autodesk and Salesforce reported), New Wave and Boozt. They are cautious on Intrum, short-term negative on Boliden after its zinc acquisition, and strongly negative on Sivers' valuation.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EKTA-B — Elekta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Profit +45%, beat by 15-20%, guidance kept, P/E ~12; market overreacted to weak sales; turnaround setup.

#### Reasoning

Host (Ulf) says the sell-off was wrong: margins strong, profit well above expectations, full-year guidance held, and P/E ~12 is cheap for a high-tech firm with a big order book. He admits trust is low after CEO changes and missed targets, but sees a turnaround with the stock far from all-time highs.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales weakness continues and competition erodes growth
- if full-year guidance is cut
- further order-book write-downs

> *"Jag är lite lång Elekta faktiskt. Den kan vara något att plocka upp."*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Weak report, unclear savings plan, heavy leverage, dilution removed low multiples, rising global rates.

#### Reasoning

Host was previously positive but now 'feels quite short'. Adj. EBIT -17% hits hard with high leverage. The rights issue diluted shareholders, so multiples are no longer low. Interest savings are unclear (700-800m) while global rates are rising. It is a binary stock that could fall 30% or double.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest costs fall materially
- if the savings programme delivers clear earnings improvement

> *"Men jag känner mig ganska kort faktiskt nu."*

---

### ⛔ BOL — Boliden | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Peru zinc acquisition adds uncertainty, a new major owner and a funding burden; host short-term short.

#### Reasoning

The deal is ~20% of market cap and adds 8% to EPS, but brings a new 7% owner, South America risk and financial strain on top of existing projects and a mine stoppage. Host expects the decline to continue short term but backs the CEO's conviction and a possible good zinc timing longer term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if zinc price keeps rising strongly
- if the deal is quickly shown to be accretive

> *"Men om något så är väl jag då lite kortsiktigt kort i Boliden på det här."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Superstrong report, CFO hinted at 70% growth next year vs 43-44% consensus; ~19x EV/EBIT; both hosts long.

#### Reasoning

Robert is at least as positive after the report: Nvidia's role is cemented even as token prices fall, growth is >100%, and next-year guidance is far above consensus while multiples are near post-ChatGPT lows. Ulf is also long and sees Nvidia as a global earnings driver.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins (75%) drop significantly
- if inference chips displace Nvidia demand
- if growth guidance is not delivered

> *"Så jag är nog minst lika positiv faktiskt."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Contrarian SaaS-death play; ~8x EBITA, ~10x cash flow; Autodesk report looked fine; licence shift a timing issue.

#### Reasoning

Robert argues the SaaS sell-off is overdone short term. Addnode, a major Autodesk reseller, has fallen hard to low multiples. The shift from 3-year to 1-year licences lowers commission now, but revenue should even out over time unless churn rises. Hosts sum up: 'long Addnode'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if customers churn on licence renewals
- if AI materially displaces Autodesk software
- further weak Autodesk reports

> *"Lång ad node, helt enkelt, på Autodesk rapport."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Falling revenue, heavy cash burn, insider selling, Q3 guided weak; ~10bn mcap unsupported by $1.2bn 5-yr pipeline.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts say the valuation can't be justified. Revenue is down 10% while peers grow ~100%, it burns 75m per quarter, losses are rising and insiders are selling. Even 100% capture of the pipeline at a 30% margin doesn't add up, and the revenue turn is pushed to Q4 (report Feb 2027). They see it as pure speculation and say value investors should head for the exit.

#### Sell Triggers

- if large real orders convert to revenue
- if Q4 revenue turns up strongly

> *"Om det finns några värdeinvesterare kvar i det här borde man kanske röra sig ganska nära utgången."*

---

### 🟢 NEWA-B — New Wave | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Over-punished after report, under 90 SEK vs ~150 peak; upside if consumer recovers; both hosts long.

#### Reasoning

Ulf sees big potential as the stock drifted down after the report while the Swedish consumer is improving (strong GDP, rising household confidence, a housing market recovery, a possibly strong Christmas season). Robert agrees and is also long.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer recovery fails to materialise
- if rising inflation leads to rate hikes

> *"Där ser jag stor potential om man kan få lite konsument i ryggen."*

---

### 🟠 BOOZT — Boozt | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fell ~7% on Ferd's full exit at a discount; overhang removed; growing with rising margins.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call it an exciting stock that is doing well, with growth and rising margins. The 7% drop came from the Norwegian owner's discounted block sale, so the selling pressure is now gone and the stock may not need to fall further.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stalls
- if margin improvement reverses

> *"Men då kan man se det som positivt att nu är den här posten borta ur det potentiella säljflödet."*

---
